text:
Hannah: spun up acacia-1k (fp32) + int8-per-channel on staging for a mixed holdout (5k short + 5k topical). posting quick findings.
Vik: pls paste top-line metrics and index config.
Diego: gist from smoke run:
```
model                      recall@1  recall@5  recall@10  p95_latency_ms
acacia-1k-fp32             0.671     0.842     0.887      29.3
acacia-1k-int8-per-channel 0.656     0.825     0.869      17.8  # int8pc latency win, small overall recall dip
index: hnswlib, M=24, ef_search=96, metric=cosine
```
Hannah: stratified by query length shows short queries impacted more:
```
short (<6): fp32=0.61 int8pc=0.53
medium:      fp32=0.68 int8pc=0.66
long:        fp32=0.72 int8pc=0.71
```
Vik: pattern matches quant noise on low-norm vectors. did you L2-normalize and try light PCA-whitening?
Diego: normalized before indexing. ran a whitening run (reg=0.02) and an int8-run with per-channel + clamp=0.03. numbers improved for short bucket: recall@1 gap shrank from 0.08 -> 0.03, p95=19.9ms. artifacts uploaded.
Hannah: please dump top 10 failure pairs for the short bucket so we can do blind human check. tag runs with ef_search in name.
Diego: done. run names:
acacia-1k-fp32-ef96-seed13.json
acacia-1k-int8pc-clamp003-ef96-seed13.json
acacia-1k-int8pc-clamp003-whiten-ef96-seed13.json

eval-bot: eval summary uploaded -> https://internal/redwood/runs/2765439999 (contains per-cohort tables, UMAPs, top failure pairs).
Vik: next steps: 1) Hannah to open Optimize regression rule for short-bucket recall@1 with 0.03 threshold, 2) Diego to run ef_search sweep (96/128/192) to quantify retrieval vs index cost, 3) If per-channel+clamp+whiten is stable, update onboarding doc recommending this quant recipe with caveat on acronyms.
Hannah: will add rule and draft the onboarding note. include the recommended run config and failure examples.
Diego: running ef sweep now, will post delta table. quick CLI commands used:
```
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model acacia-1k --quant none --index hnswlib --ef_search 96 --seed 13 --out acacia_fp32_2765439999.json
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model acacia-1k --quant int8-per-channel --clamp 0.03 --index hnswlib --ef_search 96 --seed 13 --out acacia_int8pc_clamp003_ef96_2765439999.json
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model acacia-1k --quant int8-per-channel --clamp 0.03 --whiten 0.02 --index hnswlib --ef_search 128 --seed 13 --out acacia_int8pc_whiten_ef128_2765439999.json
```
Vik: thanks. leave this thread open until ef sweep and onboarding doc update complete.
Hannah: noted, will close after doc pushed and Optimize rule in place.
Diego: ef sweep uploaded, short-bucket recall@1 for int8pc+whiten: ef96=0.58, ef128=0.60, ef192=0.61; latency p95 increases with ef. sharing tradeoff chart.
Hannah: good. looks like ef128 is sweet spot for production. I'll update doc with recommended defaults and the short-query fallback routing option.
Vik: excellent. closing actions logged in onboarding ticket.
